items.title: Beagle ka safar aur Darwin ke mushahidat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Darwin's Observations, printed pages 216-217.

blocks.text: Lambe safar ke dauran Darwin ne tropical rainforests (garam ilaqon ke ghane barsaati jangal) aur doosre naye habitats (rehne ki jaghein) dekhe, jahan unhon ne paudon aur janwaron ki itni zyada qismein (diversity) dekhin jo pehle kabhi nahin dekhi thin. Unhein aisi chattanein bhi milin jin mein fossils (purane jandaron ke pathar bane nishan) the. In mushahidaat (observations) se pata chala ke bar-e-azam (continents) aur samandar waqt ke saath bohat badle hain aur ab bhi badal rahe hain. Unhon ne bohat bare, khatam ho chuke (extinct) mammals ke fossils khod kar nikale aur dekha ke maazi mein jandar bohat mukhtalif dikhte the. Is se ishara mila ke jandar waqt ke saath badalte hain.

Jab woh Galápagos Islands (16 chhote jazeeron ka group) gaye to unhon ne dekha ke mukhtalif jazeeron ke paude aur janwar ek doosre se bohat mukhtalif the. Maslan ek jazeere ke bare kachhuon (giant tortoises) ka khol zeen (saddle) jaisa tha, jabke doosre jazeere ke kachhuon ka khol gumbad (dome) jaisa. Isi tarah bohat se paude aur janwar doosre jazeeron ke bajaye South America ke paudon aur janwaron se zyada milte the. Mazeed yeh ke aam parindon, yaani finches, ki mukhtalif species ki chonchein (beaks) mukhtalif thin. Darwin ne dekha ke chonch ke size aur shakal ka yeh farq asal mein adaptation (mahol ke mutabiq dhal jana) tha, taa ke har jazeere par bilkul mukhtalif qisam ki khuraak khayi ja sake.

Darwin ne in adaptations par ghaur kiya aur yeh samjhane ki koshish ki ke finches ki species jazeeron mein is tarah kyun phaili hui hain. Unhon ne socha ke nayi species ka banna aur adaptations aapas mein gehra ta'alluq rakhte hain. Jab koi population apni asal jagah se alag ho kar naye mahol mein rehti hai to us mein naye mahol ke mutabiq adaptations aahista aahista jama hoti hain, aur is tarah ek purani (ancestral) shakal se nayi species ban jati hai. Bohat si naslon ke baad dono populations itni mukhtalif ho sakti hain ke unhein alag alag species kaha jaye.

blocks.alt: Pankhe numa (fan) khaaka: aadhe daire ke gird das finches ke sar. Baayen: Vegetarian tree finch, Large insectivorous tree finch, Small insectivorous tree finch, Woodpecker finch (kaanta pakre); oopar: Warbler finch; daayen: Cactus ground finch, Sharp-beaked ground finch, Small ground finch, Medium ground finch, Large ground finch.

blocks.long_description: Bahar ka chhalla: Tree finches, Warbler finch, Ground finches; darmiyani chhalla chonch ki qismein: Parrotlike bill, Grasping bills, Probing bills, Crushing bills; andar khurak: Fruit eaters, Insect eaters, Cactus eaters, Seed eaters.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Khaake ko andar se bahar parhein: beech mein finch ki khurak (phal, keere, cactus, beej), us ke gird chonch ki qisam, aur sab se bahar finch ka group. Har finch ka sar apne hisse ke saamne hai: beej khane wale ground finches ki chonch moti aur mazboot (crushing) hai, keere khane walon ki patli (probing ya grasping). Aik hi buzurg se aaye finches mukhtalif khurak ke liye mukhtalif chonch mein dhal gaye.

blocks.prompt: Finches ki mukhtalif chonchon se Darwin ko kya ishara mila?
blocks.explanation: Ke chonch ki shakal har jazeere ki khuraak ke mutabiq adaptation hai, aur jab populations alag alag jazeeron par rehti hain to adaptations jama hone se woh nayi species ban sakti hain.

items: Fossils aur nayi jaghon ne dikhaya ke zameen aur jandar waqt ke saath badalte hain.
Galápagos ke kachhue (zeen ya gumbad jaisa khol) aur finches (mukhtalif chonchein) har jazeere par mukhtalif the.
Alag hui populations mein adaptations jama hone se kai naslon mein nayi species banti hai.
